title: Broncos LB Levelle Bailey suffered a broken leg vs. the Falcons

sources.title: Broncos LB Levelle Bailey suffered a broken leg vs. the Falcons
sources.description: According to 9NEWS Denver’s Mike Klis, Broncos reserve linebacker Levelle Bailey suffered a break in his lower leg during Friday’s game vs. the Falcons.
